info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/sam-3/3d-objects
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/sam-3/3d-objects queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Reconstruct one or more 3D objects from image and masks.

export_textured_glb.description: If True, exports GLB with baked texture and UVs instead of vertex colors.
export_textured_glb.title: Export Textured Glb

point_prompts.description: Point prompts for auto-segmentation when no masks provided
point_prompts.title: Point Prompts

mask_urls.description: Optional list of mask URLs (one per object). If not provided, use prompt/point_prompts/box_prompts to auto-segment, or entire image will be used.
mask_urls.title: Mask Urls

image_url.description: URL of the image to reconstruct in 3D
image_url.title: Image Url

prompt.description: Text prompt for auto-segmentation when no masks provided (e.g., 'chair', 'lamp')
prompt.title: Prompt

pointmap_url.description: Optional URL to external pointmap/depth data (NPY or NPZ format) for improved 3D reconstruction depth estimation
pointmap_url.title: Pointmap Url

detection_threshold.description: Detection confidence threshold (0.1-1.0). Lower = more detections but less precise. If not set, uses the model's default.
detection_threshold.title: Detection Threshold

box_prompts.description: Box prompts for auto-segmentation when no masks provided. Multiple boxes supported - each produces a separate object mask for 3D reconstruction.
box_prompts.title: Box Prompts

gaussian_splat.description: Gaussian splat file (.ply) - combined scene splat for multi-object, single splat otherwise

individual_glbs.description: Individual GLB mesh files per object (only for multi-object scenes)
individual_glbs.title: Individual Glbs

artifacts_zip.description: Zip bundle containing all artifacts and metadata

individual_splats.description: Individual Gaussian splat files per object (only for multi-object scenes)
individual_splats.title: Individual Splats

model_glb.description: 3D mesh in GLB format - combined scene for multi-object, single mesh otherwise

object_id.description: Optional object identifier. Prompts sharing an object id refine the same object. When a text prompt is also given, the id selects which detected object the points refine.
object_id.title: Object Id

x_max.description: X Max Coordinate of the box
x_max.title: X Max

x_min.description: X Min Coordinate of the box
x_min.title: X Min

y_max.description: Y Max Coordinate of the box
y_max.title: Y Max

object_id.description: Optional object identifier. Boxes sharing an object id refine the same object.
object_id.title: Object Id

y_min.description: Y Min Coordinate of the box
y_min.title: Y Min

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

object_index.description: Index of the object in the scene
object_index.title: Object Index

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
